legal.reviewNotice: This page is a working draft prepared for the Shany Living site. Have it reviewed by legal counsel before launch, and replace the bracketed details with the registered company information.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what personal information Shany Living Furniture collects when you browse the site, configure a sofa or place an order, and how that information is used.

sections.heading: Who we are
sections.body: Shany Living Furniture, Herzl 34, Tel Aviv, Israel. Company registration number [to be completed]. For any privacy question, write to info@shanyliving.com.

sections.heading: What we collect
sections.body: Contact details you enter at checkout or in a consultation request (name, email, phone, delivery address); the sofa configuration you build; order and payment status; and basic technical data such as your language preference and the pages you visit.

sections.heading: Why we use it
sections.body: To prepare quotes, produce and deliver your order, provide advisor support over WhatsApp or phone, and keep records required by Israeli tax and consumer law.

sections.heading: Who we share it with
sections.body: Delivery contractors, our production workshop, and the payment provider handling your transaction. We do not sell personal information, and we do not share it for advertising without your consent.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: Under the Israeli Protection of Privacy Law you may ask to see the personal information we hold about you, correct it, or ask us to delete it where we are not required to keep it. Send the request to info@shanyliving.com and we will respond within a reasonable period.

sections.heading: Cookies
sections.body: The site stores your language choice and cart contents in your browser. These are required for the site to work and are not used to track you across other sites.

terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.intro: These terms apply to the Shany Living site and to made-to-order furniture purchased through it.

sections.heading: Made-to-order products
sections.body: Sofas are produced to the size, configuration, fabric and colour you select. Because each piece is made for you, the specification is confirmed with an advisor before production begins.

sections.heading: Prices and quotes
sections.body: Prices shown are in new Israeli shekels and include VAT unless stated otherwise. Items marked price on request are quoted individually, and a written quote is valid for the period stated on it.

sections.heading: Orders and payment
sections.body: An order is created when you submit your details on the site. Payment is arranged with your advisor by secure payment link, bank transfer or by phone. Production is scheduled after payment terms are agreed.

sections.heading: Delivery and assembly
sections.body: Estimated production and delivery times are given at the time of order and confirmed by your advisor. Delivery includes placement in the room of your choice and assembly where required.

sections.heading: Cancellation and returns
sections.body: Consumer cancellation rights under Israeli law apply, with the exception for goods manufactured specially for the customer. Your advisor will explain what applies to your specific order before production starts.

sections.heading: Warranty
sections.body: Frames and workmanship are covered against manufacturing defects for the period stated on your order confirmation. Normal wear, misuse and unapproved alterations are not covered.

accessibility.title: Accessibility Statement
accessibility.intro: Shany Living wants the site and the showroom to be usable by everyone, including people using assistive technology.

sections.heading: What we have done
sections.body: The site is built with semantic headings and landmarks, keyboard focus styles, text alternatives for images, colour contrast checked in both light and dark themes, and layouts that reflow down to small screens without horizontal scrolling.

sections.heading: Standard we aim for
sections.body: We work towards the Israeli standard SI 5568, which is based on WCAG 2.0 level AA. Some areas are still being improved, in particular third-party embedded content such as the map.

sections.heading: The showroom
sections.body: Our Herzl 34 showroom is at street level. Call 03-1234567 before your visit and the team will arrange assistance and a quiet time slot if that helps.

sections.heading: Accessibility coordinator
sections.body: Contact [name to be completed] at info@shanyliving.com or 03-1234567 with any accessibility problem you hit on the site. Tell us the page and what happened, and we will respond and fix what we can.

sections.heading: Reporting a problem
sections.body: If something on this site blocks you, we treat it as a defect. Report it and we will give you the information or complete the task with you by phone or WhatsApp in the meantime.

shipping.title: Shipping and Delivery
shipping.intro: How we build, ship and install your furniture across Israel, and what to expect at each step.

sections.heading: Production time
sections.body: Made-to-order sofas leave production 4 to 6 weeks after the specification is confirmed. Stocked pieces and accessories ship within 5 business days. Your advisor confirms the schedule in writing once the order is placed.

sections.heading: Delivery areas
sections.body: We deliver across Israel. Tel Aviv and the central district are covered by our own crews; other regions are served by partner carriers. Delivery outside the central district may add a few days to the schedule.

sections.heading: Delivery fees
sections.body: Delivery and assembly are quoted with the order and depend on the region, the number of pieces and access at the address. The fee appears on the order before you approve it, and is not calculated automatically at checkout.

sections.heading: Booking a delivery slot
sections.body: We call two to three days before delivery to agree a window. Someone over 18 must be present to receive the furniture and sign for it.

sections.heading: Access and assembly
sections.body: Tell us in advance about narrow staircases, lifts, tight doorways or crane requirements so the crew arrives prepared. Standard delivery includes carrying the pieces in, assembling them in the room and removing the packaging.

sections.heading: Inspection on arrival
sections.body: Check the furniture with the crew before they leave and note anything on the delivery form. Report transport damage within 48 hours with photographs so we can resolve it quickly.

sections.heading: Missed deliveries
sections.body: If nobody is at the address for the agreed window, the crew leaves and a second delivery is scheduled. A repeat delivery fee may apply.

sections.heading: Returns and cancellations
sections.body: Made-to-order pieces are produced for you and cannot be returned once production begins. Cancellations before production starts are handled by your advisor. Stocked items follow the return rights in the Israeli Consumer Protection Law.

warranty.title: Warranty
warranty.intro: What the Shany Living warranty covers, for how long, and how to open a claim.

sections.heading: Frame and structure
sections.body: The internal frame and structural joinery carry a 10 year warranty against manufacturing defects under normal domestic use.

sections.heading: Cushions and suspension
sections.body: Seat and back cushion cores, webbing and springs carry a 5 year warranty. Softening and settling of foam and feather fill is normal and is not a defect.

sections.heading: Upholstery and stitching
sections.body: Fabric, leather and stitching carry a 2 year warranty against manufacturing defects. Fading from direct sunlight, pilling from abrasion, stains and pet damage are not covered.

sections.heading: Mechanisms and legs
sections.body: Recliner mechanisms, sofa bed frames, castors and legs carry a 2 year warranty on parts and labour.

sections.heading: What is not covered
sections.body: Normal wear, damage from misuse, accidents, cleaning products not recommended for the material, alterations made after delivery, commercial use and pieces sold as showroom clearance are outside the warranty.

sections.heading: Opening a claim
sections.body: Send your order reference and photographs of the issue from the Messages tab in your account, or contact your advisor. We assess the claim and repair, replace the part or replace the piece, in that order of preference.

sections.heading: Care and cleaning
sections.body: Rotate and plump cushions weekly, vacuum upholstery with a soft brush, blot spills immediately and keep furniture out of direct sunlight and away from heaters. Following the care card supplied with the order keeps the warranty valid.

sections.heading: Transfer
sections.body: The warranty covers the original purchaser at the delivery address and is not transferable when the furniture is sold on.

items.question: How does the sofa customizer work?
items.answer: Pick a model, then set the size, configuration, fabric and colour step by step. The preview updates as you choose, and your design is saved to your account so you can come back to it.

items.question: How many fabrics can I choose from?
items.answer: Over 120 fabrics and leathers, grouped by feel and durability. Order free swatches from the showroom page if you want to see them at home before deciding.

items.question: Can I order a size that is not listed?
items.answer: Yes. Tell your advisor the dimensions you need and we quote the piece as a bespoke build. Bespoke sizes take the same 4 to 6 weeks as standard made-to-order pieces.

items.question: Do I need an account to save a design?
items.answer: Yes, saved designs live in your account so an advisor can pick them up with you. Signing in with Google takes a few seconds.

items.question: How do I place an order?
items.answer: Add the piece to your cart and complete checkout. The order is created and saved to your account immediately, and an advisor confirms the specification with you before production starts.

items.question: How do I pay?
items.answer: Payment is arranged with your advisor by secure link, bank transfer or over the phone. No card details are taken on the website.

items.question: Can I change my order after placing it?
items.answer: Yes, until production starts. Contact your advisor with the order reference and we will update the specification or the delivery address.

items.question: Where do I track my order?
items.answer: In My Orders in your account. Every order shows its reference, status and items, and the status moves as the piece goes through production and delivery.

items.question: How long does delivery take?
items.answer: Made-to-order pieces leave production 4 to 6 weeks after the specification is confirmed. Stocked items ship within 5 business days.

items.question: Do you assemble the furniture?
items.answer: Yes. Standard delivery includes carrying the pieces in, assembling them in the room and taking the packaging away.

items.question: How much is delivery?
items.answer: Delivery is quoted with the order and depends on the region, the number of pieces and access at the address. It is not calculated automatically at checkout.

items.question: What does the warranty cover?
items.answer: Ten years on the frame, five on cushion cores and suspension, and two on upholstery and mechanisms. The warranty page has the full terms.

items.question: How do I clean my sofa?
items.answer: Vacuum with a soft brush, blot spills straight away and use only the products named on the care card supplied with your order. Keep the piece out of direct sunlight.

items.question: Can I buy replacement cushion covers?
items.answer: Yes, if the fabric is still in the collection. Send your order reference to your advisor and we will quote the covers.
